description.narrative: The project will enhance the competitiveness of Pakse as a regional economic and tourism center of the southern Lao PDR. It responds to the local government's vision for Pakse to become a green city and for the greater Pakse urban area to gain official city status in the future by improving citywide environmental improvements in solid waste management, flood protection and drainage, and riverbank erosion protection along the Xedon River; supporting community-driven initiatives in urban environmental improvements; strengthening local capacity in urban planning and services; and strengthening local capacity in project management and implementation. The project contributes to the Government of the Lao PDR's long-term urbanization strategy and Pakse Urban Development Strategy, 2011-2030.

description.narrative: Increased quality, reliability, and coverage of urban infrastructure and environmental improvements in greater Pakse urban area.

At least 42 urban villages developed participatory urban environmental improvement plans (2012: None) Achievement: 13 Progress/Status: total of 43 urban villages achieved development of participatory urban environmental improvement plans (25 villages in Pakse, 10 villages in Phonthong and 8 villages in Bachieng) vs. the target of 42 villages Data Source: Pakse UDAA monthly reports Pakse district reports and statistics Champasack provincial reports and statistics Consultant reports

At least 125,000 residents benefit from the Project (2011: 107,000 people in project area) Achievement: 22672.4 Progress/Status: About 113,362 residents benefited from the project Data Source: Pakse UDAA monthly reports Pakse district reports and statistics Champasack provincial reports and statistics Consultant reports

Number of households served by improved solid waste management increased by 30% (2011: 21% of 107,000 people) Achievement: 42 Progress/Status: number of households served by the improve solid waste management is about 9,000 households or 45,000 people vs. the target of 107,000 people based on the 2011 baseline data due to waste collection system which needs to be improved after completion of the sanitary landfill and the landfill starts its operations (the achievement figure is being collected) Data Source: Pakse UDAA monthly reports Pakse district reports and statistics Champasack provincial reports and statistics Consultant reports

Annual flood damages to households reduced by 20% (2011:2,895 households affected) Achievement: 42 Progress/Status: the annual flood damages to households reduced by 42% about 1,230 households affected by flood damages in 2018 vs. the target of 2,895 households in 2011 Data Source: Pakse UDAA monthly reports Pakse district reports and statistics Champasack provincial reports and statistics Consultant reports

Riverbank erosion along Xedon River constructed to 1:30 year flood levels (2011: less than 1:10 year flood levels) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: the project completed construction of the riverbank erosion protection along Xedone river for 1:30 year flood levels vs. the target of 1:10 year flood level in 2011 Data Source: Pakse UDAA monthly reports Pakse district reports and statistics Champasack provincial reports and statistics Consultant reports Baseline value: 1:10
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: City-wide environmental improvements - strengthened flood protection and drainage Indicator: 7,500 meters of secondary drains are constructed Achievement: 3000 Progress/Status: 5,118 m of secondary drains (concrete pipe culverts) are constructed. Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

Output: City-wide environmental improvements - strengthened flood protection and drainage Indicator: At least 6,000 meters of primary drains are constructed Achievement: 2000 Progress/Status: Project completed construction of 8,982.3 meters of primary drains (concrete drains and box culverts) and 5,118 meters of secondary drains (concrete pipe culverts).
Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

Output: Community-driven urban environmental improvements - improved solid waste collection and management; improved household sanitation. Indicator: At least 12,000 household have improved their toilets to pour flush standards (2005: 10,577 households have a pour flush toilet) Achievement: 3000 Progress/Status: A total of 18,428 households have improved their toilets to septic tank toilets (not pout-flush standards). Data Source: - Project progress and completion reports Urban village plans and agreements - Construction records

Output: City-wide environmental improvements - strengthened flood protection and drainage Indicator: At least 80% of flood retention areas are retained (2011: 17.40 hectares demarcated) Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: The project achieved a total of 14.3 ha (82.2%) of retention pond areas were cleaned, rehabilitated and improved Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

Output: City-wide environmental improvements - strengthened flood protection and drainage Indicator: At least 2,900 meters of access roads are improved (2011: 2,965 m require improvement) Achievement: 1400 Progress/Status: A total of 6,075.52 meters of existing and new roads including associated drainage were improved and constructed to paved roads with double bituminous surface treatment (DBST). Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

The project supported rehabilitation of 3 flap gates and construction of 1 new flap gate. Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

Output: City-wide environmental improvements - strengthened flood protection and drainage Indicator: At least 4,400 meters of drains are cleaned and rehabilitated (2011: 4,430 meters of drainage require rehabilitation) Achievement: 2400 Progress/Status: a total of 4,430 meters of drains were cleaned and rehabilitated using water jetting trucks and manual labor. Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports

Data Source: Subproject feasibility and appraisal reports Construction records Project progress and completion reports
